objective: Bring Rumbleshot's Ammo to Hegnar Rumbleshot in Dun Morogh.

description: Hegnar Rumbleshot sells guns off the road to Anvilmar.  Riflemen and mortar teams spend a lot of time practicing out near his shop, and he's always needing fresh ammunition.
But... the last crate of ammo I sent him got lost along the way.  My courier said he was camped near the Grizzled Den when wendigo chased him away... and the fool left Rumbleshot's ammo behind!
<name>, can you get that ammo and take it to Rumbleshot?  He's been waiting on it and I'm sure he's running low.
progress: I hope you're not here for ammo, because I'm almost out!
completion: Great, more ammo! Old Loslor's shipment finally came through! The ammo might be late, but just like my grand daddy used to tell me: late's better than never!
Thank you much, <name>. I already have buyers eager for this stuff!
